purpose: Same-composition delivery derivatives for eight exact cards; originals retained.

methodology.resize: Lanczos3, aspect preserved, exact square source; no sharpening
methodology.color: 8-bit sRGB RGB; originals are 3-channel sRGB without alpha
methodology.codec: WebP lossy; effort=6, smartSubsample=true; qualities 88 and 92
methodology.sameSizeMetric: Source PNG is resized once losslessly to the target width. RGB PSNR/MAE compare the decoded WebP against that exact same-size RGB reference. Metrics measure codec loss, not loss from resizing.
methodology.dprMetric: Separately compare source resized directly to 220*DPR with the selected-size WebP decoded and resized to the same 220*DPR physical pixels. This includes codec and two-stage resampling effects.
methodology.psnrFormula: 10*log10(255^2 / mean((referenceRGB-decodedRGB)^2)); no universal pass threshold inferred.

selection.reason: q92 improves RGB PSNR over q88 for every one of the 32 same-size comparisons. CPU visual review of all 8 at 96 and 256 plus representative 512/768 magnified detail confirms maintained content/edge readability. q92 retains more fine detail at modest per-card cost.
selection.reviewBoundary: Static local decoded-image comparisons only. No browser, GPU, on-device, network timing or in-game loading verification.

thumbnail.note: 96px is a physical image dimension; use a larger source when the thumbnail physical requirement exceeds 96.

suggestedUse.master: Original PNG source URL for provenance/fallback only; normal compressed delivery uses thumb or sources.
